# Pronouns

## What you will learn
Subject pronouns replace the subject: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Object pronouns receive an action: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.

## Example in context
Maria knows Tom. She knows him.

## How to use it
Read the example aloud. Identify the rule, then make a new sentence with your own words. Check word order and spelling.

## Common mistake
Use he as a subject and him as an object.

## Practice and reflection
Replace names: Anna sees Mark → ___ sees ___.
**Model answer:** She sees him.

Try changing one word in the example without breaking the rule.
levels.easy:
## In simple words
Subject pronouns replace the subject: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Object pronouns receive an action: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.

**Remember this example:** Maria knows Tom. She knows him.

**Be careful:** Use he as a subject and him as an object.
